newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Playboy buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Playboy buy reiterated.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co Inc said Friday it reiterated a buy recommendation on Playboy Enterprises Inc, with a 12-month price target on the stock of $24.

--Analyst Rita Zanella Benson, in a report, cited Playboy's announced affiliation agreement with cable operator Tele-Communications Inc which allows that company to launch Playboy's pay-per-view AdulTVision on its systems.
--Benson also noted that Playboy Home Video will become available in the new DVD format with some 30 titles to be released each year, starting in May.
